description: This file defines an internal sealed class `ExactMatchChannelNamespacePredicate` implementing `IChannelNamespacePredicate`, which provides functionality for matching stream namespace strings exactly, used for filtering or selecting streams with a specific namespace within the Orleans broadcast channel system.

classes.name: ExactMatchChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: A predicate class that matches stream namespace strings exactly, used in Orleans broadcast channel filtering.

methods.name: ExactMatchChannelNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a target stream namespace.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Returns the predicate string pattern used for matching, combining the prefix and the target namespace.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the given stream namespace string matches the target namespace exactly.
